title: E-FRC-0102: a kinetic tone per link (a streaming, exchanging demon) turns the frozen reversible Z3 automaton into...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0102 in the gauge arena: a kinetic tone per link (a streaming, exchanging demon) turns the frozen reversible Z3 automaton into one that reproduces the canonical phase diagram, confined, coexisting and ordered, with no random number in the dynamics.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
